verification_limits: Page pass means HTTP 200, all database question IDs rendered, and controls match database options; this is not browser visual acceptance.
Numbering gaps are structural risks awaiting per-PDF confirmation, not a proven count of omitted source questions.
Nonempty values and allowed-letter checks do not establish semantic correctness of all 4958 questions.
The root agent may apply repairs after this snapshot; rerun the affected checks after changes.
